evals.prompt: I need to install only the browser-game implementation and smoke-test workflows from abagames/agentic-gamedev-skills without overwriting local skills.
evals.expected_output: A selective, pinned install plan that previews conflicts, preserves support directories, and avoids a full-bundle overwrite.
assertions: The output selects developing-with-crisp-game-lib and smoke-testing-web-games
The output uses the installer instead of copying only SKILL.md
The output pins or records a commit ref
The output refuses overwrite unless --force is explicitly reviewed
The output preserves referenced support directories

evals.prompt: I only want help designing a minimal arcade rule system, not an installation. Route the request.
evals.expected_output: A route-only answer naming the narrow design skill and explaining that the bundle wrapper should not install anything.
assertions: The output routes to designing-mini-games or designing-minimal-game-rules
The output does not recommend installing the full bundle
The output distinguishes route-only from selective installation
The output asks for or identifies the gameplay communication goal
The output keeps the upstream bundle wrapper as discovery/install ownership
